name: Model-Optimizer
description: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search, speculative decoding, etc. It compresses deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, etc. to optimize inference speed.
one_liner: A toolkit that shrinks and speeds up AI models (making them smaller and cheaper to run) without needing a PhD in machine learning.
buyer: An ML infrastructure lead at an AI startup whose GPU inference bill is too high and needs to cut model size without retraining from scratch.
business_use_cases: An AI startup running a chatbot in production uses it to quantize their model, cutting their monthly cloud GPU bill by shrinking model size.
A hardware-constrained startup (on-device AI, robotics) uses it to compress a model to fit on cheaper edge hardware instead of a costly custom chip.
An MLOps consultant runs a 'cut your inference costs' audit for clients, using it to benchmark before/after savings as the pitch.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'inference cost audit' service for AI startups, using it to quantify and deliver savings.
Charge a percentage of the GPU-cost savings achieved as a performance-based consulting fee.

steal_this: This is a dev library for ML engineers, not an end-user product — the buildable weekend project is a one-page 'before/after cost calculator' demo you can show a startup CTO to sell the audit service, not a standalone app.
